svg.title: PaperWing tour
svg.desc: An animated walkthrough: browse an organization, add repositories to a set, pick branches and tags, clone in parallel, right-click for actions, review and commit changes, branch into a new folder, compare folders and delete safely. Repository and organization names are sample data.

g.text: Nothing selected. Tick repositories in the table to see where they will be cloned.
Add rate limiter to public routes
Commit message — the first line is the summary
Keep it in its own folder, next to api-gateway
api-gateway stays on its current branch. A new copy is cloned into
rate-limits, switched to feature/rate-limits, and added to this set.
Created feature/rate-limits in its own folder
Double-click a file for a side-by-side diff
Delete the set "Platform"? The repositories stay on
disk unless you also remove them below.
Also move the 4 cloned folders to the Recycle Bin
1 of them has uncommitted changes or unpushed
commits that would go with the folder.
Moved 4 folders to the Recycle Bin
Clone, switch, commit and compare many Git repositories — together.
A quick tour — with sample repositories
Many repositories. One place. Any branch.
Group repos from any org or host and keep them
Pick a ref per repo, then clone, fetch, pull
Commit, branch, push, compare and open in VS
See every change, stage exactly what you mean.
Work on a branch right next to the original.
No force pushes; deletes ask first and use the
Windows · uses your own git and SSH setup · light and dark themes
1 · Browse an organization and add repositories to a set
2 · Choose a branch, tag or commit for each repository
4 · Right-click any repository for everything you can do
5 · Review every change side by side, stage, commit — then push
6 · Branch off into its own folder, right next to the original
7 · Compare folders or branches, and copy either way
